::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Febry 10th [1870s?]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

Dear Sir,

Many thanks for your paper, which shall certainly go into the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd). I have been asked to call for some such spoon meat for [a packet of small books](cmy_books/cmybook_211.qmd) for [Mr Warne](people/person_1433.qmd), and as your Elsie’s Dream seems to me just the right thing in length and material for the purpose, I venture to ask if you would object to its so appearing instead of in the Monthly Packet.[^1] Mr Warne promises £2 for each tale, and I think in this manner it will probably sooner appear.

yours truly
C M Yonge

&nbsp;

---

[^1]: There was more than one series of ‘Warne’s Victoria Toy Books:  A Packet of Twelve Nursery Stories’, and they are treated variously by cataloguers, since they appeared as  ‘Edited by the Author of *The Heir of Redclyffe*’.  Some assume this means that CMY wrote them. According to WorldCat the only surviving copy of *Ella’s Dream* is owned by the University of Florida.
